title: Solar Panel for Trail Camera – Skip the Battery Change Mid-Season
descriptionHtml:
Every battery change is a trip into the area

The camera always dies when things get most interesting — and to change batteries you have to walk in, leaving scent and noise right where you'd rather be invisible. Then it sits there for another three weeks before you get back, and you don't know if it's actually running.

The panel charges the camera where it hangs

The solar panel is mounted next to the camera and keeps it running on daylight. The mount turns to face south no matter how the tree stands, and once you've rigged it you don't need to go into the area for power again.

The lifestyle image is an AI-generated illustration.

Features

  • You don't have to go in to change batteries – the panel charges the camera where it sits
  • Angles toward the sun however the tree stands – hinged mount, not a fixed angle
  • Stays up all season – built to be mounted outdoors and left
  • Screws onto a trunk, post or wall – wall bracket comes with the panel

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
